page: OVHcloud r2-60 is a memory-optimized server instance running on a KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by an Intel Haswell processor operating at 2.2 GHz. The system is equipped with 60.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 15.0 GB per core. Local storage consists of a bundled 100 GB SSD, and the instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor performance is relatively limited. The single-core stress-ng CPU performance score of 840.98 falls into the bottom 10%, while the multi-core score of 3186.26 is in the bottom 25%. Memory bandwidth tests show an average performance of 339.78 GB/sec for small cached blocks, but uncached large block read-only bandwidth drops to a poor 19.87 GB/sec. Similarly, the PassMark CPU score of 4451.4 and Geekbench multi-core score of 2991.0 reflect weak overall computational throughput.

This server is configured for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high CPU performance. With 60.0 GB of RAM, it supports caching layers and memory-resident databases, though database operations scored in the bottom 25% with 2246.34 operations in PassMark. The lack of high-speed network bandwidth and weak CPU performance make it less suitable for heavy computational tasks, large-scale LLM inference, or high-throughput web serving.
